prompt.text:
Implement deterministic reconciliation of causally versioned records in package `solution`.

Export:

```go
type Version struct {
    Origin  string
    Counter uint64
    Seen    map[string]uint64
    Logical uint64
    Value   string
}

type MergedRecord struct {
    Versions []Version
    Sources  []string
}

func MergeReplicaReads(reads []map[string][]Version, mode string) (map[string]MergedRecord, error)
```

A version `a` causally supersedes `b` when they have the same `(Origin, Counter)`, or when `a.Seen[b.Origin] >= b.Counter`. Invalid versions have an empty origin or counter zero. The same dot appearing with different fields is malformed. Exact duplicates should be collapsed.

For each key, discard every version superseded by another retained candidate. In mode `"siblings"`, return all remaining versions ordered by origin, then counter, then value. In mode `"latest"`, retain only the version with greatest `Logical`; ties are broken by lexicographically greatest origin, then greatest counter. Any other mode is an error.

`Sources` is the sorted, duplicate-free set of origins appearing among all valid input versions for that key, including superseded ones. Nil and empty reads are valid and produce an empty non-nil result. All maps, slices, and `Seen` maps in the result must be newly allocated so later input mutation cannot change the result.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
